# CHECK THE SHOP

San Jose cannabis license-record lookup. State status and city address matches are separate. Results are dated snapshots, not findings of legality.

- [One shop. Two records.](https://eugiene300-maker.github.io/check-the-shop/guide-two-checks.html)
- [The sign isn’t always the legal name.](https://eugiene300-maker.github.io/check-the-shop/guide-names-and-addresses.html)
- [Can’t find the shop? Start here.](https://eugiene300-maker.github.io/check-the-shop/guide-no-match.html)

- [Sources](https://eugiene300-maker.github.io/check-the-shop/sources.html)
- [Public data](https://eugiene300-maker.github.io/check-the-shop/data.json)
